create_robot_sim: create a Robot instance with a MuJoCo model path to initialize a simulated robot environment
get_sensors: get sensor data from the robot simulation or hardware and return current joint positions and velocities
step_robot: step the robot forward by applying control commands and simulating physics for a given duration
reset_robot: reset the robot to specified joint positions and velocities with enforced actuator limits
configure_robot: configure robot sensors and actuators from a config file and compile with the MuJoCo model
